Group.trigger: initial Group proposal applied to the saved Builder workspace

ChoicePreview.trigger: construction-choice-proposals request started for a selected field command

ChoicePreviewComplete.trigger: successful ready choice preview with rendered rows for the same command ID

ChoicePreviewError.trigger: choice preview request failed or returned an unusable preview

EditGroup.trigger: COUNT_DISTINCT Group proposal applied before adding the related source

EditGroupAgain.trigger: Group round-trip proposal applied while retaining the related source

Preview.trigger: native construction proposal preview request started

PreviewComplete.trigger: native proposal preview response completed and rendered

PreviewError.trigger: native proposal preview failed or was rejected

LatePreviewCompleteIgnored.trigger: late preview response arrived after a newer proposal owner and was ignored

LatePreviewErrorIgnored.trigger: late preview failure arrived after a newer proposal owner and was ignored

PreviewRequestCancelled.trigger: current pending proposal preview request was cancelled without changing its observation

GroupEditCancel.trigger: Group edit was cancelled and actual before/after Builder reads prove saved state is unchanged

GroupRemovalCancel.trigger: Group removal was cancelled and actual before/after Builder reads prove saved state is unchanged

Reload.trigger: fresh postreload Builder read and mounted Group projection agree with persisted state

ExpandRows.trigger: native related-row expansion proposal applied and actual Builder draft CAS advanced

RelatedSourcePreview.trigger: native RELATED_SOURCE proposal response and owner are retained; a consumed candidate also binds its later ready-panel DOM to that exact request

RelatedSourceApply.trigger: current RELATED_SOURCE proposal applied and actual saved Builder projection read back

RelatedSourceCancel.trigger: current RELATED_SOURCE proposal cancelled and actual saved Builder projection stayed unchanged

unmodeledEventPolicy.builder-read: Read-only Builder responses retain actual saved workspace and draft snapshots.
unmodeledEventPolicy.population-route-read: Read-only population route discovery supplies the native source route.
unmodeledEventPolicy.construction-capability-read: Read-only construction capability discovery supplies chooser availability.
unmodeledEventPolicy.semantic-inventory-read: Read-only semantic inventory supplies current source fields.
unmodeledEventPolicy.construction-choice-read: Read-only construction choice discovery supplies related-source choices.
unmodeledEventPolicy.configured-column-context-read: A configured-column context read supplies the selected source projection.
unmodeledEventPolicy.related-field-choice-read: A related-field choice read supplies the native selected field candidate.
unmodeledEventPolicy.related-expand-choice-read: Read-only related expansion choices supply the selected row route.
unmodeledEventPolicy.related-expand-contributor-read: A related expansion contributor read supplies the exact native contributor choice.
unmodeledEventPolicy.construction-input-read: A construction input read supplies the current saved step context.
unmodeledEventPolicy.construction-category-discovery-read: A category discovery read supplies the native selected category.
unmodeledEventPolicy.table-preview-read: Read-only source table previews are retained as supporting observations.
unmodeledEventPolicy.draft-reconcile-read: A draft reconciliation read is retained as support for the current persisted Builder state.
unmodeledEventPolicy.capability-read: A read-only capability response supplies the current Builder authoring choices.
unmodeledEventPolicy.row-definition-choices-read: A read-only row-definition choice response supplies the current Builder row configuration options.
